topic_a_inefficiencies.description: method_wikidata.py swallows all exceptions with bare except.
No standard error envelope across methods.
deduplicate_results uses nested loop comparing every pair.
similarity_score computes IDF from only 2 documents, making it meaningless.
Keyword overlap check (>=3) is too loose, producing false corroboration.
websearch and iterative execute DDG queries sequentially instead of parallel.
Flagged in iteration 1 but never fixed.
No rate limiting anywhere. Hybrid sends bursts of requests.
Benchmark runs execute each method twice (standalone + inside hybrid).
Exists in two locations with different implementations.
Prefix stripping order means 'https://www.' never matches.
SCR-0009 describes hybrid as 3 sources but code uses 5.
DG-0006, DG-0007, dedup_utils not registered in parent scripts index.
No validation that index.json matches files on disk.
builds_on field never validated for cycles or dangling refs.
All entries share 2026-03-10, undermining temporal tracking.

unique_findings: IDF computed from 2 docs makes TF-IDF meaningless
Corroboration inflation via loose keyword matching
coordination_notes: 3+6 structure optimal. Agent 3A (code) found algorithmic bugs via deep subagent analysis. Agent 3B (structural) found workflow gaps. Agent 3C (tools) provided concrete specs. Total: 19 findings in 48s.
